nav.source: latestRoundData() on the Chainlink proxy, read live from Base's public RPC (reused for up to 30 s inside the server; responses are not CDN-cached)
nav.label: Last published total-return reference per token, not a live equity price. It already includes dividends and splits.

staleness.method: v2: count only regular-session (trading) seconds between the last round and now, across days. threshold = max(2 × the feed's p99 in-session gap between official rounds, 30 min). fresh (market open) / expected_closed (market closed) while that trading time is within the threshold; unexpectedly_stale once it exceeds it, open or closed. A NAV stuck through whole sessions accumulates trading time and is flagged.
